technicalChecks.result: All nine selected processed PNGs are non-empty RGBA files with transparent pixels. The shared preparer centered approved artwork without upscaling; rendered XHS cards and responsive course screenshots were inspected separately in runs/day74/verification/.

accepted.review: A complete empty bar and rack, a shallow bodyweight squat and a coaching gesture convey orderly training without weight markings, timers or unsafe loading.
The supported seated rest posture, flat feet, stable bench and complete light dumbbell make recovery-for-quality clear without an artificial timer cue.
The adjusted composition keeps a modest medicine ball at Despa's chest, complete characters and a stable bench; it explains technical-priority order without arrows or sequence numbers.
A controlled bodyweight squat has flat feet, natural knee alignment and a neutral trunk, with no jump, speed lines or risky load.
A blank rigid card in a small holder, one-finger gesture and complete light dumbbell communicate recording before changing one factor; there are no loose sheets, text or charts.
The dedicated 4:3 seated-rest composition differs from the knowledge strip and keeps bench, feet, dumbbell and coaching gesture fully visible.
The dedicated overview scene separates a calm medicine-ball hold from the knowledge-page composition and uses a complete stable bench without directional symbols.
The overview-only controlled squat preserves full feet and posture, with the instructor observing; it has no jump or tempo symbol.
The separate 4:3 scene uses one blank rigid card, one complete dumbbell and a coaching gesture, distinct from the knowledge-page card-holder scene.

rejected.reason: The medicine ball was oversized and the character's head was too close to the canvas edge; the adjusted second attempt fixed both composition issues.

result: Nine selected source assets passed local visual, alpha, semantic and equipment-safety QA. Rejected candidates and their adjusted prompts remain preserved in image-request-log.json.
